hypotheses.operatorDomain: Dom(D) consists of sequences with sum k^2(|a_(k,+)|^2+|a_(k,-)|^2)<infinity; its adjoint domain is the same.
hypotheses.zeroSpectrum: The zeros of the det2 candidate are the signed integer spectrum with multiplicity. They are not asserted to be Riemann zeros.
hypotheses.regularizedDeterminant: Use det2(I-z D^-1), normalized by F(0)=1 and F'(0)=0, with no extra trivial-zero factor.
hypotheses.trace: The inverse-square trace is the sum of squared reciprocal eigenvalues; finite cutoffs need separate tails.
hypotheses.duality: The paired signed spectrum proposes F(z)=F(-z). A relation to xi requires a further unproved bridge.
hypotheses.positivity: The supplied identity quadratic form is positive; it does not identify any Riemann Weil-positivity form.

criteria.title: 전역 정규화와 모든 국소 인자를 완성한다
criteria.text:
ζ의 completed ξ와 E의 Λ_E=N_E^{s/2}(2 π)^{-s}Γ(s)L(E,s)를 각각 명세한다. minimum model/Tate reduction, root
number, bad factors의 certificate를 묶는다. 합격: good-only product는 L^S라고 표시한다. ζ↔ξ 또는 L↔ Λ의 영점·극
점·trivial zero 차이가 자동 변환 기록에 남는다.
implemented: Fresh official PARI 2.19.0 global minimal model and Tate reduction, including additive examples; independently checked five-coefficient transform and all discriminant factors.
All good/bad Euler data, Tamagawa/conductor/root-number products and all finite coefficients checked against independent exact prime counts and Euler recurrence.
Root implementation normalization.py automatically records zeta/xi and L/Lambda zero, pole and trivial-zero conversions; good-only products are typed L^S.
Complete-local-only public helper omits descent, torsion and heights so general complex L continuation is independent of their success.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Exact supported rational models, pinned CAS Tate/minimal algorithms and independently checked exported arithmetic; no rank database or hidden Manin constant.
researchLimitations: The CAS minimality/local-solubility algorithms are external computational dependencies, not newly formalized Lean theorems.

Verify the corresponding new public UI result, exact scope labels and exported evidence after publication.

criteria.title: 해석적 연장 backend와 Euler-product 영역을 분리한다
criteria.text:
유한 Euler product는 ζ에서 Re(s)>1, E good-factor product에서 Re(s)>3/2의 탐색으로 제한한다. critical strip 계산은
certified analytic continuation과 complex balls를 사용한다. 합격: s=1/2+it에서 finite Euler product를 ζ의 인증값으로
반환하면 실패한다. 반올림·series truncation·tail error를 각각 포함한 ball을 내보낸다.
implemented: Explicit zeta Euler-Maclaurin evaluation with finite arithmetic balls, integrated unit-cell binomial-series truncation, and separate infinite [B,infinity) tail.
Strict finite Euler-product domains Re(s)>1 for zeta and Re(s)>3/2 for elliptic good factors; critical-strip substitution is rejected.
General complex elliptic Mellin continuation from complete minimal/Tate/coefficient data, with upper-incomplete-gamma finite evaluation and an explicit remaining coefficient tail.
Official PARI ellan(E,1) boundary failure fixed by computing at least two coefficients and exporting exactly the requested K-prefix; K=1 and its tail remain K=1.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Certified analytic continuation with explicit finite truncation and infinite tail ledgers, distinct from finite Euler exploration.
researchLimitations: Primitive FLINT special-function enclosures include their internal numerical approximation; the explicit higher-level series and infinite tails are separate. No claim of a new proof of modularity is made.
remainingObligations: Observe the final source-bound combined unit/API gate (fresh CLI runs and all 25 fresh replays already passed).
Verify the corresponding new public UI result, exact scope labels and exported evidence after publication.

criteria.title: 영점 고립·개수·중복도를 인증한다
criteria.text:
N(T)는 0<Imρ≤T인 strip 전체 영점의 중복도 포함 개수로 정의한다. Hardy Z의 실수 영점 고립으로 Re ρ=1/2를 인증하고 독
립 zero counter와 비교한다. T=20,30의 endpoint exclusion도 확인한다. 합격: N(20)=1, N(30)=3을 count certificate
로 재확인한다. 임계선에서 찾은 영점 수와 전체 strip의 count가 다르면 RH_VERIFIED_TO_T를 주지 않는다.
implemented: Whole-strip argument-principle count with multiplicity and pole correction is independent as an algorithm from Hardy-Z critical-line isolation.
Fresh current-source T=20 and T=30 acceptance runs have complete boundary exclusion and count saturation: N(20)=1 and N(30)=3; both separate CLI replays matched.
Current typed-result tests freshly recompute T=20 and reject omission of the one positive zero index.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The two original finite heights and algorithmic independence; a common FLINT arithmetic backend is disclosed.
researchLimitations: Other requested heights, a second independent arithmetic implementation, and a new Lean argument-principle proof are not claimed or required by these two original acceptance examples.
remainingObligations: Observe the final source-bound combined unit/API gate (fresh CLI runs and all 25 fresh replays already passed).
Verify the corresponding new public UI result, exact scope labels and exported evidence after publication.

criteria.title: 명시적 공식의 유한 잘림 오차를 계산한다
criteria.text:
우선 x를 half-integer로 제한한 ψ(x)와 symmetric zero sum을 제공한다. 숫자 오차 밴드는 선택한 truncated/smoothed
formula의 명시 상수·가정·tail bound가 있을 때만 인증한다. 합격: x=10.5의 prime side=log2520. ψ 또는 ψ₀ endpoint
convention을 기록한다. 이름만 있는 O(·)나 수치 residual을 rigorous tail bound로 쓰면 실패한다.
implemented: Half-integer psi uses the absolutely convergent integrated explicit formula and unit secant, with symmetric zero data, explicit constants and standard theorem dependencies.
The actual independent prime side at x=10.5 is log(2520); psi versus psi0 endpoint conventions are recorded.
Finite sum, explicit nontrivial/trivial tails and numerical enclosures are separate; no fitted residual or unnamed O-term is treated as a rigorous tail.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The original half-integer finite acceptance case with a rigorous but coarse smoothed band.
researchLimitations: The finite T=30 band is coarse; a narrow error band or arbitrary-height extension is not asserted. The unsmoothed diagnostic does not borrow the smoothed tail.
remainingObligations: Observe the final source-bound combined unit/API gate (fresh CLI runs and all 25 fresh replays already passed).
Verify the corresponding new public UI result, exact scope labels and exported evidence after publication.

criteria.title: global operator 후보를 반증 가능한 입력으로 만든다
criteria.text:
사용자가 operator/domain, spectrum-zero 대응, regularized determinant, trace formula, duality/positivity 가설을 등
록하게 한다. truncation별 spectrum·극점·중복도·정규화·functional-equation residual을 비교한다. 합격: 누락 영점, 잘못
된 trivial-zero factor, determinant의 상수/선형 exponential normalization 차이, multiplicity 불일치는 counterexample
후보로 저장한다. 유한 통과가 전체 operator의 존재나 RH 증명이 되지 않는다.
implemented: User registrations preserve unique IDs and exact operator/domain, zero-spectrum, determinant, trace, duality and positivity hypothesis text.

Two to four editable rational-matrix cutoffs carry complete spectrum/poles/multiplicities and constant/linear exponential normalization, exact trace/reflection checks and rigorous finite residual probes.

Ten actual counterexample mutations include every originally named missing-zero, trivial-factor, constant/linear normalization and multiplicity error, plus domain/trace/positivity/reflection controls.
Invalid baselines receive no vacuous negative-control PASS; infinite operator/domain and RH remain independent research obligations.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Editable research registration and falsifiable finite comparisons; finite matrix success is never a global existence theorem.
researchLimitations: No operator with the classical zeta zero spectrum is constructed or proved to exist. Rational finite spectra and bounded dimensions are the implemented comparison domain.

criteria.title: analytic rank를 증명 범위별로 계산한다
criteria.text:
root-number 대칭으로 강제되는 vanishing과 exact modular-symbol vanishing, 도함수의 rigorous nonzero ball을 구분
한다. completed Λ의 Taylor parity를 사용한다. 합격: w=−1이면 Λ(1)=0의 정확한 이유를 기록하고 0∉ Λ′(1)의 인증구간
이 있어야 rank=1. 0을 포함하는 작은 interval은 vanishing 증명이 아니다.
implemented: Exact root-number parity forces the central completed Lambda zero for 37a1; the rigorous first derivative interval excludes zero and certifies analytic rank 1.
11a1 has a certified central L interval excluding zero, hence analytic rank 0 with stated analytic theorem dependencies.
Parity-exact vanishing, derivative zero exclusion and exact modular-symbol evidence are separate channels; a small interval containing zero is not exact vanishing.

Actual pinned GP plus-new modular symbols for 11a1 and 37a1 yield exact nonzero/zero central path values; independent Fraction checks verify lifted eigensymbols, complete Manin relations, joint Hecke nullity one and a 12-coefficient Sturm identity.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The original root-number -1 acceptance condition and rigorous central derivative, with exact vanishing mechanisms distinguished.
researchLimitations: The central parity/derivative producer correctly records modularSymbolsExecuted=false because the independently executed exact modular-symbol route is a separate result. Its 37a1 zero alone gives analytic rank at least one, not exact rank one.
General higher analytic rank and new Lean modularity/analytic-continuation proofs are not claimed.
remainingObligations: Observe the final source-bound combined unit/API gate (fresh CLI runs and all 25 fresh replays already passed).
Verify the corresponding new public UI result, exact scope labels and exported evidence after publication.

criteria.title: arithmetic rank와 leading BSD data를 독립 인증한다
criteria.text:
독 립 유 리 점 ·height/ regulator 로 lower bound, descent/ Selmer certificate 로 upper bound 를 얻 는 다. tor-
sion·saturation·Tamagawa·period·Sha 의 known/ conditional/ unknown 을 각 각 저 장 한 다. 합 격: rank interval
[r_min,r_max]가 한 점일 때만 해당 곡선 rank 확정. Sage L_ratio() 등의 숨은 Manin-constant 가정이 충족되지 않으면 조
건부로 표시한다.
implemented: Independent exact rational points, explicit canonical-height duplication bounds and positive Gram determinants supply arithmetic rank lower bounds.
Fresh pinned PARI 2-descent/Cassels data supplies upper=C-T-s; exact rational maps of every exported 2-cover are independently checked.
Actual 11a1 [0,0] and 37a1 [1,1], plus additive examples, collapse their arithmetic intervals without analytic rank or database inference.
Exact torsion/reduction bounds, full rank-one saturation by exhaustive height-bounded rational point enumeration, full regulator and rigorously integrated full real period are recorded separately.
Sha finiteness/order stays UNKNOWN; direct minimal Neron period does not hide a Manin-constant assumption.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Exact supported arithmetic computations plus standard height theorems and pinned CAS descent dependencies; the full finite witness and raw GP output remain inspectable.
researchLimitations: Selmer local-solubility/basis completeness and CAS Tate algorithms remain explicit external algorithm dependencies.
Full Sha order, universal BSD and an arbitrary-rank saturated Mordell-Weil basis are not inferred.
remainingObligations: Observe the final source-bound combined unit/API gate (fresh CLI runs and all 25 fresh replays already passed).
Verify the corresponding new public UI result, exact scope labels and exported evidence after publication.

criteria.title: RH·BSD 연구 결과를 제한된 범위로 내보낸다
criteria.text:
finite-height zero certificate, 특정 curve의 rank equality, refined leading-term 검증, universal conjecture를 별도 결
과 타입으로 제공한다. coefficient/prime/zero completeness의 빠진 항을 자동 목록화한다. 합격: 한 E에서 두 rank가 같
다고 universal BSD를 표시하지 않는다. finite-field RH theorem을 classical RH axiom으로 복사하는 요청은 거부한다. 연
구가설은 Lean 가정 목록과 함께 내보낸다.
implemented: Four distinct result types execute fresh underlying finite zero, arithmetic and analytic producers; one-curve rank equality is separate from refined leading terms and universal conjectures.
Missing/extra/duplicate coefficient, prime and zero inventories are automatically listed against fresh exact expected data.
Actual tests reject coefficient 17, prime 37 and zero 1 omissions, valid rank-upper deletion after resealing, one-curve-to-universal promotion, and finite-field RH axiom copying into classical RH.
Refined type retains independent Sha finiteness/order obligations; optional Sha=1 is only a research assumption and interval overlap is never an identity proof.

Research statements/IDs export beside explicit Lean proposition and proof binders; semantic translation is unperformed. Actual example binder-conjunction compilation succeeds, while removing h2 fails.
criteria.acceptanceScope: Typed finite/research results, complete finite inventories, scope rejection and transparent assumption export; no natural-language-to-Lean mathematical formalization is claimed.
researchLimitations: The research export theorem bundles opaque proposition assumptions only. A formal mathematical operator/trace/RH bridge still needs explicit definitions and a proof.
Independent Sha information remains missing in the refined example; this is an open dependency inside a implemented result type, not a universal BSD proof.
remainingObligations: Observe the final source-bound combined unit/API gate (fresh CLI runs and all 25 fresh replays already passed).
Verify the corresponding new public UI result, exact scope labels and exported evidence after publication.
